info.title: ekg-backend API
info.description: The governed /api surface. Writes are classic REST commands (this document): the Odoo ingestion webhook and human oversight of action points (list / read / promote / abort / undo) and of portfolios (promote / undo / abort, each one governed step across every member). Reads are served by the separate read-only GraphQL surface at POST /api/graphql, which defines no mutation root: every governed mutation stays an explicit REST command here. Plus operational liveness + readiness.

get.summary:
`GET /api/action-points`: lists every action point from Restate state introspection
(durable state, authoritative for display).
get.description:
# Errors
[`Problem`] (502) if the Restate admin introspection is unreachable or malformed.

post.summary:
`POST /api/action-points/abort`: the stop control (`open` or `proposed` to `aborted`),
no write-back. The abort claims the point, then records.
post.description:
# Errors
[`Problem`] (422) if the reviewer or reason is empty or the reviewer is a `policy:`
identity; (404) if no point exists; (409) if the point cannot be aborted from its
current state or another command holds it; (502) if the Restate ingress is unreachable.

204.description: Aborted via the stop control; no write-back

404.description: No action point for that subject

409.description: Point cannot be aborted from its current state, or another command is in progress on it

422.description: Missing oversight evidence: an empty reviewer or reason, or a policy: reviewer

get.summary:
`GET /api/action-points/one?subject=<iri>`: one point, with the proposal and the
omissions the reviewer has to see.
get.description:
# Errors
[`Problem`] (404) if no point exists for the subject; (502) if the Restate ingress
is unreachable or returns an undecodable point.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: The subject entity IRI (the point key)

200.description: The action point for the subject

404.description: No action point for that subject

post.summary:
`POST /api/action-points/promote`: the governed write-back. Only a `proposed` point can
be promoted: the command validates its evidence, claims the point, runs the write-back
in-process and records it durably (`proposed`, then `under_review`, then `promoted`).
post.description:
# Errors
[`Problem`] (422) if the reviewer or rationale is empty or the reviewer is a `policy:`
identity; (404) if no point exists; (409) if it is not `proposed`, another command holds
it, or the selected option is missing or stale; (502) if the governed write-back or the
durable record fails.

404.description: No action point for that subject

409.description: Point is not proposed, another command is in progress on it, or (with a slate) the selected option_rank_key is missing, unknown/stale, or the slate has no promotable option

422.description: Missing oversight evidence: an empty reviewer or rationale, or a policy: reviewer

post.summary:
`POST /api/action-points/undo`: reverse an auto-applied change, or a plan a human approved
on this point alone, within its reversal window. Only a `promoted` point can be undone:
the undo claims the point, runs the governed inverse write-back (the reversible
`OdooActionExecutor` path the plan was committed on) and records it durably
(`promoted` to `reversed`). An undo requested after the window has closed is refused with
an explicit reason.
post.description:
# Errors
[`Problem`] (422) if the reviewer or reason is empty or the reviewer is a `policy:`
identity; (404) if no point exists; (409) if it is not `promoted`, was promoted through its
portfolio (undo the portfolio instead), has no executed plan, the reversal window has closed
(or no applied time is recorded), or another command holds it; (502) if the governed
reverse or the durable record fails.

404.description: No action point for that subject

409.description: Point is not promoted, was promoted through its portfolio (undo the portfolio), has no plan, the window closed, or another command is in progress on it

422.description: Missing oversight evidence: an empty reviewer or reason, or a policy: reviewer

get.summary: `GET /api/health`: liveness. Always `200` while the process serves.

200.description: The process is up and serving

post.summary:
The webhook handler: authenticate and scope-check, then submit the parsed ref to
the durable worker via the Restate ingress. Rejections return without pulling,
submitting or writing anything. A submit that cannot reach Restate answers 503;
the reconciliation sweep is the backstop.

202.description: Accepted; submitted to the durable ingest worker

post.summary:
`POST /api/portfolios/abort`: dismiss an active portfolio's plan as one governed step:
claim every member, record the portfolio dismissed, then abort each member. Writes nothing
to any system of record.
post.description:
# Errors
[`Problem`] (422) for missing oversight evidence; (404) for an unknown portfolio; (409)
when the portfolio is not active, the generation is stale, or a member is held by another
command, changing nothing; (502) when a member's abort does not record after the portfolio
was dismissed (its claim is held; a retry aborts only the members still awaiting).

200.description: Dismissed; every member aborted. The portfolio record

409.description: The portfolio is not active, the generation is stale, or another command is in progress on a member; nothing is changed

422.description: Missing oversight evidence: an empty reviewer or reason, or a policy: reviewer

502.description: A member's abort did not record after the dismissal (a retry aborts only the members still awaiting) or an ingress failure

post.summary:
`POST /api/portfolios/promote`: promote one option of a portfolio's joint slate as one
governed step across every member: claim every member, run one all-or-nothing
write-back, record the portfolio's promotion and then each member's.
post.description:
# Errors
[`Problem`] (422) for missing oversight evidence; (404) for an unknown portfolio; (409)
when the portfolio is not active, the generation is stale, it has no joint slate for it,
the option is not on it, or a member is not proposed or is held by another command,
writing nothing; (502) if the write-back or a durable record fails.

200.description: Promoted across every member; the portfolio record

409.description: The portfolio is not active, the generation is stale, it has no joint slate for that generation, the option is not on it, or a member is not proposed or another command is in progress on it; nothing is written

422.description: Missing oversight evidence: an empty reviewer or rationale, or a policy: reviewer

post.summary:
`POST /api/portfolios/undo`: undo a promoted portfolio's plan as one governed step,
within the reversal window: claim every member, reverse what is left of the executed plan
and record every member and the portfolio reversed or record the progress and answer
502 naming what remains.
post.description:
# Errors
[`Problem`] (422) for missing oversight evidence; (404) for an unknown portfolio; (409)
when it is not promoted, its window closed, or a member is held by another command,
reversing nothing; (502) if the reverse is partial (naming how many actions remain) or a
durable record fails.

200.description: Reversed across every member; the portfolio record

409.description: The portfolio is not promoted, its reversal window closed, or another command is in progress on a member; nothing is reversed

422.description: Missing oversight evidence: an empty reviewer or reason, or a policy: reviewer

502.description: The reverse was partial (the reason states how many actions remain; a later undo resumes) or an ingress failure

get.summary:
`GET /api/ready`: readiness. Probes each hard dependency concurrently and answers `200`
(all reachable) or `503` (any unreachable).

AbortInput.description: Abort a point via the stop control.

reason.description: Their reason, recorded in the audit trail. Required and non-empty.

reviewer.description: The reviewer invoking the stop control. Non-empty, and never a `policy:` identity.

HealthStatus.description: Liveness body: the process is up and serving.

PortfolioAbortInput.description: Dismiss an active portfolio's plan: abort every member, write nothing to Odoo.

generation.description: The generation the reviewer saw; it must be the portfolio's current one.

reason.description: Their reason, recorded in the audit trail. Required and non-empty.

reviewer.description:
The reviewer dismissing (identity; no auth yet). Non-empty, and never a `policy:`
identity.

PortfolioPromoteInput.description: Promote one option of a portfolio's joint slate across every member.

context_seen.description: A record of the context the reviewer was shown.

generation.description: The generation the reviewer decided for; it must be the portfolio's current one.

option_rank_key.description:
The `rank_key` of the joint-slate option the reviewer selected. Opaque ordering id,
never a capability or metric name.

reviewer.description:
The reviewer promoting (identity; no auth yet). Non-empty, and never a `policy:`
identity.

PortfolioUndoInput.description: Undo a promoted portfolio within its reversal window.

reason.description: Their reason, recorded in the audit trail. Required and non-empty.

reviewer.description: The reviewer requesting the undo. Non-empty, and never a `policy:` identity.

Problem.description: An RFC-7807 error body. Serialized as `application/problem+json`.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type (`about:blank` for generic).

PromoteInput.description: Promote a proposed point: who, why, and what they saw.

context_seen.description: A record of the context the reviewer was shown.

option_rank_key.description:
The `rank_key` of the slate option the reviewer selected. Required when the point
carries a slate (the promotion commits that option's plan; an unknown/stale key is
refused). Ignored when the point has no slate: the staged proposal is promoted.
An opaque ordering id, never a capability or metric name.

reviewer.description:
The reviewer promoting (identity; no auth yet). Non-empty, and never a `policy:`
identity (reserved for the auto-apply policy).

subject.description: The subject entity IRI (the action point's key).

ReadinessStatus.description: Readiness body: the aggregate verdict plus a per-dependency reachability map.

dependencies.description: Per-dependency reachability (`ok` or `unreachable`), keyed by name.

status.description: `ready` when every dependency is reachable, else `not_ready`.

UndoInput.description: Undo an auto-applied change within its reversal window.

reason.description: Their reason, recorded in the audit trail. Required and non-empty.

reviewer.description:
The reviewer requesting the undo (identity; no auth yet). Non-empty, and never a
`policy:` identity.

subject.description: The subject entity IRI (the action point's key).
